findings.finding: Packaged renderer-context fence creation failure responds with OK_NODATA. This cannot certify a native display-reader dependency or be reused as a successful display release.
Global renderer fence watermark retires commands by fence_id; native display consumers need an explicit joined dependency so renderer-only progress cannot signal their completion.
Context fences have ctx/ring/fence identity. Native display release must not be attributed to an unrelated renderer ring or global fence.
Console blocks around a synchronous void display callback and unblocks after return. ABI1 callback return does not carry actual native terminal/error status.
Resource-flush wait ignores timeout verdict; a 50ms timeout cannot authorize overwriting an active Metal reader.
Primary host3d path does not acquire the dumb-buffer flush fence. Standard object/property presence alone does not repair producer/native-reader synchronization.
